title: Retry loop hammers the payments API without backoff

pr_metadata.title: Faster charge retries
pr_metadata.body: Drop the sleeps; five quick attempts.

labels.defect: Zero-delay retry loop: 5 immediate retries amplify outages and can double-charge on slow-success responses
labels.evidence: Reproducible: during a processor brownout each caller issues 5 requests/interval instead of 1; two retried charges that both land after the timeout produce duplicate charges with no idempotency guard in sight.
